description: This file implements the HandleBusMessage class, which processes GStreamer bus messages related to WebAudioPlayer state changes, end-of-stream, and errors within the Rialto server's WebAudio task module.

classes.name: HandleBusMessage
classes.description: A class responsible for handling GStreamer bus messages related to WebAudioPlayer state changes, end-of-stream, and errors.

methods.name: HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HandleBusMessage object with context, player, client, wrappers, and message.

methods.name: ~HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of HandleBusMessage processing.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes the GStreamer message, updates player state, handles end-of-stream and error conditions, and performs cleanup.
